summary: Six-phase plan implementing Option B (dual-form continuation-pointer acceptance) with a proven-RED-first regression suite, dispatch-context normalization, hard-engine reader symmetry, and a handoff-schema.md rewrite.

memory_candidates.content: When a system has one executable predicate plus hand-applied prose copies of the same rule across multiple SKILL.md engines, a field-shape divergence between writer and reader hides in the copies, not the script. The reliable audit move is to grep the field name tree-wide and classify every hit as writer, reader, validator, or doc: a validator that already accepts BOTH shapes (here validate-handoff.sh accepting continuation_path OR continuation_context) is strong evidence that relaxing the strict reader codifies existing precedent rather than inventing a new contract, and it identifies which direction of convergence has the smaller blast radius.
